question_evidence_quote: There are 60 passengers on a bus. Children make up 25% of the bus riders.
observed_error: The response reports 30 adults without showing a calculation.
violated_condition: Adults must constitute 100% − 25% = 75% of the 60 passengers.
error_description: The response reports 30 adults, which is half of the 60 passengers. Since children constitute 25% of riders, adults must constitute the remaining 75%. No calculation is shown to establish how the incorrect count arose.
uncertainty_note: The final count is demonstrably incorrect, but the text does not reveal an incorrect intermediate relation or arithmetic execution.
